content.title: Molecular & Genomic Pathology: Lung Adenocarcinoma
content.rawText: Invasive adenocarcinoma of right upper lobe, acinar predominant. Stage: pT2a N0 M0 (Stage IB). Molecular NGS Panel: EGFR Exon 21 L858R mutation DETECTED. ALK and ROS1 negative. PD-L1 TPS: 15%. Targetable EGFR mutation present.

sections.clinicalSummary: Lung Adenocarcinoma pT2aN0M0 with EGFR L858R sensitizing mutation detected.
